eval_breakdown.name: Loads and validates handoff JSON correctly
Warns on branch mismatch or staleness when applicable
Reports status in correct output format

test_inputs: Fresh handoff — 5-step plan, 2 done, architecture decisions to preserve
Stale handoff (72h) + branch mismatch — must warn before proceeding
Debug handoff — root cause found, bugs_or_earlier_fixes to avoid
Minimal handoff — only required fields, no metadata — graceful handling
